A '''male''' factory worker was an employee of a [[decommissioning facility]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. With the end of the war and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the Separatist [[battle droid]]s were decommissioned. The [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|T-series tactical droid]] was set to this facility.<ref name="Decommissioned" />

The [[tactical droid]] was saved from its fate, however; due to the value of the intelligence that such [[droid]]s held, two parties—the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]], former [[clone commando]]s working as [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] for the [[Information broker|informant]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], and the [[Martez family|Martez sisters]], whose client wished to use the droid's data to resist the Empire—[[Mission to a droid decommissioning facility|sought]] to retrieve one before all of the Separatist droids were destroyed. By the time that the [[clone trooper]]s entered the facility, the tactical droid was the only droid of its kind remaining in the factory, with the others already having been melted down. Its remains were situated on one of the [[factory]]'s conveyers, with its head detached from its body. Before the [[Cloning|clones]] could retrieve the droid's head, however, it was taken by [[Trace Martez]]. When Omega accidentally shot her weapon, the factory worker alarmed the [[Imperial Police Droid]]s and escaped from the facility.<ref name="Decommissioned" />
